title: Lasting Candy
description: Every other combat, your card rewards gain an additional Power.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Only obtainable after Ironclad's first run. Tracks combats seen; activates on every other combat (starting from the 2nd combat). When activated, adds a random Power card to combat card rewards. Displays a counter showing the combat cycle (0 or 1) and flashes visually when activating.
